articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a vastly expanded context window reaching 1M tokens. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap to domain-specific expert systems.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini Ultra 2 with Real-Time Agentic Capabilities
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which integrates persistent memory, tool use, and autonomous task execution directly into the model architecture. The system can independently browse the web, write and execute code, and manage multi-step workflows, marking a significant step toward fully autonomous AI agents for enterprise use.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Warehouse Logistics End-to-End
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas humanoid robot completing full warehouse pick-pack-ship cycles without human intervention, using a new foundation model for manipulation trained on millions of grasping scenarios. The company announced commercial pilot deployments with three major logistics providers beginning Q3 2026.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across European Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across five additional European manufacturing plants. The robots now handle complex sub-assembly tasks including wire harness routing and quality inspection, leveraging on-device vision-language models for real-time decision making on the production floor.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Opus 4 with Verifiable Chain-of-Thought Auditing
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4, emphasizing interpretability with a new verifiable reasoning trace feature that allows enterprises to audit the model's full chain-of-thought for compliance and correctness. The model also demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on agentic coding benchmarks and long-document analysis tasks exceeding 500K tokens.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node has entered high-volume manufacturing several months ahead of the original timeline, delivering a 20% performance improvement and 35% power reduction over its 2nm node. The accelerated schedule is driven by surging demand from AI accelerator chips, with Apple and NVIDIA among the first customers.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trials in Paralysis Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical trial to 50 additional participants with spinal cord injuries and ALS. Recent trial data showed patients achieving cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks, and the latest N2 implant iteration offers twice the electrode density with a fully wireless, rechargeable design.

articles.title: Toyota Research Institute Demonstrates Kitchen Robot That Learns New Recipes from Video
articles.summary: TRI showcased a dual-arm mobile manipulator that can watch a single cooking demonstration video and reproduce the recipe in a real kitchen, handling deformable ingredients and varied utensils. The system combines a large behavior model with sim-to-real transfer and tactile sensing, representing a major leap in generalization for household robotics.
